0.description: I've been closely monitoring the isle's climatic fluctuations. Perhaps you'd like to know whether to expect rain, shine, or something more esoteric?
0.translation_description: Ho seguito da vicino le variazioni climatiche dell’isola. Vuoi sapere se sono previste pioggia, sole o condizioni più insolite?

1.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEATHERFORECAST_00925_WEATHERFORECAST_000_010
1.description: We are currently experiencing an auroral mirage.
1.translation_description: Al momento stiamo assistendo a un miraggio aurorale.

2.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEATHERFORECAST_00925_WEATHERFORECAST_000_020
2.description: Unfortunately, I've been unable to pinpoint the specific atmospheric conditions that lead to what I have dubbed “auroral mirages,” and thus can't offer precise predictions regarding their timing.
2.translation_description: Purtroppo non sono riuscito a individuare le specifiche condizioni atmosferiche che causano quelli che ho soprannominato «miraggi aurorali», quindi non posso prevederne con precisione l’arrivo.
